items.body: The `[rpc]` return check's keyed arm (A79's `handle_element`/`handle_key`) reads `KeyedCell<K, T>`'s second argument for the Wire bound and never the first. Add the `K: Wire` (and `Hashable`, as `KeyedSource` requires) check beside it with the method's vocabulary ("the key type `NotWire` of `[rpc]` method `tasks` is not Wire"); pin the refusal and a `KeyedCell<i32, T>` control; `service_layer.rs`.

Measure: Ir per `SignalCell::new` before/after, on kolt's client warm.

items.title: NEW — HOLD-COUNTING vs remote-sources §3: the server counts a client's leases per channel and revokes at zero (A92), so a RAW client that sends `Subscribe` twice and `Unsubscribe` once holds its channel open until disconnect; the alternative — client-side demand coordination that never double-subscribes — is plumbing the generated client already does and a raw client would have to repeat. Rule whether the wire contract is 'one Unsubscribe per Subscribe' (documented, as built) or the server forgives

items.status: OPEN — filed at Order 34's GO (2026-09-13); OWNER Q, not queued
items.body: Rec: keep the contract as built (one `Unsubscribe` per `Subscribe`; the generated client keeps it by construction) and document it at the wire page; a forgiving server would need per-client-per-channel dedup that A92 deliberately did not add (a mirror held by two demands must not be revoked under one). Pin the raw double-subscribe as the documented behaviour.
